notes.title: Demo 2.0 is now available!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the 100 Steps Demo 2.0 is now available for players. With this new release, you'll be able to dive even deeper into the game world, discover more systems, enemies, power-ups, items, and test more strategies – all to fully experience the game. 

[b][i]Note! Progress made in Demo 2.0 will be saved in the full version of the game after purchase. [/i][/b]

[h2]What does Demo 2.0 bring? From "what was" to "what is now": [/h2]

[b]Progress  [/b]
Allowed up to level 10 -> Allowed up to level 50 

[b]Power-ups  [/b]
First row unlockable -> First two rows unlockable 

[b]Characters  [/b]
Two playable characters -> Three playable characters 

[b]Systems  [/b]
Previously only available systems: trinkets, character skills, and power-ups (no gaining steps, notebook, altar, trinket positioning, etc.) -> All systems available 

[b]Items  [/b]
Limited number of items/trinkets/weapons to unlock -> All NON-CURSED items/trinkets/weapons available 

[b]Cursed Mode  [/b]
Unavailable -> Available 

[h2]What Demo 2.0 doesn't include but is available in the full version of the game: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Levels 51-100  
[*] All Cursed items  
[*] Cursed Vendor, Cursed Blacksmith, Cursed Chests  
[*] Power-up rows 3 and 4  
[*] Seals  
[*] 7 playable heroes  
[*] Access to Leaderboards and Achievements 
[/list]

notes.title: The Leaderboard Has Arrived for 100 Steps!
notes.content:
100 Steps is an epic medieval fantasy roguelite tower-crawling game. Each playthrough is a unique adventure, offering you a limited arsenal of 100 actions to explore, battle, scavenge, shop from vendors, and more. 

But, for those who dare to defy the game's basic rules, there are ways to surpass the 100-action limit. 

[h1]Leaderboard [/h1]

We've introduced a brand-new leaderboard system that automatically tracks your score. Now, you can put your skills to the test against fellow gamers. 

Do you have what it takes to claim the top spot and dethrone the current champion, [b]ENDORTH[/b], the game's creator? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/38c1f01d21d01699d59919db39f71966bc86c483.png[/img]

notes.title: Break the rules and see the wrath of the gods
notes.content:
You've become a mere pawn in the game of the divine, where they observe your relentless struggle within the Tower's depths, seeking their amusement. One rule binds you to this place, a mere 100 steps; 100 steps that mark your ascent toward divinity. But can this rule be bent or even broken? 
  
[h1]Enter the Cursed Mode [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/2b374799b729c5d13bf9103d24e68745aa78fdbf.png[/img]
If you are smart, learn the rules and make good use of what fate gives you, you can break One Rule. However, go beyond the threshold of 100 steps, and you'll incur the wrath of the gods, revealing their true nature. Their fury will taint all that surrounds you. 
  
[h2]Empowered Enemies [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/d61bb315fa0bbf3091d301a5cbf6faaec66a654e.png[/img]
This is where the real challenge begins. If you believed you'd outwitted the divine, prepare for a humbling. Even mightier enemies, capable of summoning minions, shall stand in your path. They'll halt at nothing to thwart you. 

[h2]Empowered Items [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/f7b4a9b02d7e344d733126c57c44952e13963df4.png[/img]
Yet, it's not just your foes that grow stronger. The gods' wrath transforms everything it touches. Cursed chests conceal accursed items: weapons, trinkets, potions, and seals imbued with the gods' fury—a destructive force wielded in your hands. Fight fire with fire... or curse with curse. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/c4f4474090c57f4827d66739778ec7f71b7ff992.png[/img]
  
[h2]Empowered Improvements [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/3aa76757ed1c7bc9a1ef1f1d84c9d83d860ae4b7.png[/img]
The Vendor and Forge themselves will undergo changes. You can now purchase cursed items from the Vendor or elevate your equipment to previously unattainable heights in the forge. 


What awaits at the tower's top? Assuming you evade the wrath of the gods. No one can say for certain. Nonetheless, should you reach it, before achieving godhood, be ready for one final unwinnable battle!

notes.title: Every move counts, so plan carefully
notes.content:
In 100 steps it matters what you do, every move counts and your counter goes down. Every time you perform an action in the game, your opponent will also perform a move, the enemy is not sleeping! 

You move on a hexagonal board whose sides consist of 6 hexagonal fields. You have 100 steps, how high can you go in your pursuit of glory? 

[h1]There is a way, there’s always a way [/h1]

Although the task seems difficult, 100 steps to achieve the goal, do not be afraid, you will be able to use some help 

[h2]Attack and collect loot [/h2]

On each floor of the tower, you will encounter enemies who will successively strive to annihilate you. Whether in close combat or from a distance, slain enemies can drop valuable items and coins. Of course, you can always run to the gate, but how long do you think you can avoid fighting? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/a0e8cb2771dfa63a9a8130dd1039375d0a3916b0.gif[/img]

[h2]Trinkets - if it shines it's mine [/h2]

These are powerful items that affect your stats. You can improve your defense, attack and ranged attack. They can also affect the number of fields you can cover in one move, a many other properties that you will discover on your own. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/f61b9bbea41c86562100d91fce048c3a05b433d6.gif[/img]

[h2]Shop and upgrade [/h2]

From time to time, you will meet Vendor and Forger on your way. There are powerful items waiting for you in the shop, so make sure you have enough coins. In the forge, you can make powerful items even more powerful. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/00ff8b01e6f6b656153cba62390a709cf8a4c08f.gif[/img]

[h2]Chests - open and pull out the card [/h2]

The chests contain a lot of useful items. Here you will find more powerful weapons, trinkets that will improve your statistics or the number of fields you can cover in one move, as well as gold for which you can buy valuable items. You decide which card you take, it's your tactic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532012/45d56c3cd9f9ddcb6a2e2b51207b08642a0deebd.gif[/img]

[h2]Feats - you deserved a reward [/h2]

As you try, and fail, and try again, and fail again, you will unlock new items that can spawn during runs, as well as new playable characters with unique skills and a set of initial stats. 

[h2]Power-ups - this is forever [/h2]

Each match will award you points that you can spend on power-ups. This will stay with you forever. Unlocked power-ups will be active in each subsequent game. 

 

These are just some of the systems that will help you reach the top of the tower. Is it better to attack, run away, buy items? You will have to find your own way to join the pantheon of gods.
